channel.description: Latest articles from The Hollywood Reporter Inc. (thr.com)

item.title: Grammys 2026: Inside the Star-Studded Parties and Events
item.description: Check out all the happenings surrounding music's biggest night.

item.title: Oscar-Nominated ‘The Secret Agent’ Director Decries “Outdated” Casting Practices in Rotterdam Fest Talk: “It’s Not About Good Looks”
item.description: At IFFR, Kleber Mendonça Filho and Spanish director Carla Simón also laud work with non-professional actors and the authenticity of kids on set, except for some influencer-ish and agency children.

item.title: Fred Armisen to Host CNN Series Exploring Universal Music’s Archives (Exclusive)
item.description: This series opens the doors to one of the most extraordinary music archives in the world, and Fred Armisen is the perfect guide,” CNN executive Amy Entelis said.

item.title: L.A. Olympics Boss Casey Wasserman Gets Mired In Epstein Emails
item.description: After a new tranche of DoJ emails arrives showing correspondence between him and Ghislaine Maxwell in the early 2000s, the Hollywood mogul says of Maxwell and Jeffrey Epstein, "I am terribly sorry for having any association with either of them."

item.title: Noah Kahan Documentary Film Set at Netflix Ahead of Album Launch (Exclusive)
item.description: Director Nick Sweeney's feature follows the musician as he experiences the whirlwind success of breakthrough release 'Stick Season.'

item.title: Molly Ringwald Says John Hughes’ “Didn’t Want” His Films to Be Remade
item.description: Hughes died of a heart attack at 59 in 2009. He wrote and directed a myriad of beloved movies, including 'Sixteen Candles,' 'The Breakfast Club' and 'Pretty in Pink,' all of which Ringwald starred in.
